method.kind: coherence difference (fire pair minus control pair)

act4.method: mean inside the burn polygon vs the rest of the grid, computed from the products, not from the PNG layers
act4.answer: Between 2026-06-29 and 2026-07-11, HV changes -0.67 dB inside the scar and -0.27 dB outside; HH -0.27 and -0.14 dB. Net of the change outside, that is -0.40 dB in HV and -0.13 dB in HH: small, a few tenths of a dB, with speckle dominating at pixel level. It fits the standing-trunk hypothesis (HH, sensitive to trunk echo, hardly moves; the HV volume signal drops a little), but that explanation is not tested. Coherence, not brightness, is the fire signal: inside the scar it is 0.28 in the fire pair against 0.70 in the control pair (a drop of 0.42); outside it is 0.53 and 0.63.
